title: studio → pipelines: a chat was deleted
description: From API 1.42 (plan 18, 22.3). Written by studio's outbox in the transaction that deletes the chat's rows (DELETE /v1/studio/assistant/threads/{id}); subject `cmd.assistant.delete` (stream CMD, durable `pipelines`), Nats-Msg-Id `<thread_id>:delete`. pipelines drops the thread's checkpoints (`adelete_thread`) and the chat's summary, only in owner_id's namespace; the other items the chat saved stay (their thread_id turns null). Idempotent: a thread already gone is acked.
